projectDescription: An AI-powered operating system for physician-supervised peptide therapy clinics — combining a customer CRM, SMS reorder bot, order management, financial tracking, and automated clinic notifications in one platform.
keyFeatures: Customer CRM with order history, LTV tracking, and reorder cadence
AI-powered SMS reorder bot with category-aware menu browsing
Human-takeover inbox for live operator override of bot conversations
Financial tracking: P&L, daily sales ledger, payroll, and goals
Multi-format exports (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, PNG)
In-OS AI assistant with confirm-before-write safety gate
Referral tree visualization with revenue rollups
Payment-gated order flow: orders commit only after Clover invoice payment
A2P-compliant SMS opt-in portal with STOP/HELP/START handling
Light and dark theme with per-clinic branding
publicApiSurface: POST /api/ops/reply — send manual SMS reply from inbox
POST /api/ops/takeover — toggle AI/human control of a thread
GET /api/ops/threads — list active bot conversation threads
POST /api/opt-in — record SMS consent from the public opt-in portal
